methodology.aggregation: Metrics are computed for each Monte Carlo realization, averaged within each outer fold, then averaged equally across the three folds.
methodology.error_abstraction: Only global URA list-level missed detections and false alarms are emulated. No separate payload-bit-error axis is used.
methodology.fa_region_tags: Each FA has a uniformly random valid region tag. The implementation uses the equivalent binomial thinning of the global FA count to determine contamination of the target regional receiver.
methodology.fa_task_payload: Uniformly random valid quantized task word for each scheme. A false task payload may equal a genuine task payload.
methodology.full_message_uniqueness: Synthetic disjoint nonce/message IDs guarantee that FA full messages were not transmitted. Their physical bit length is not used by the synthetic impairment generator.
methodology.operational_metrics: MDR@FAR<=1% and MDR@FAR<=5% are ROC operating metrics; no test-derived deployment threshold is exported.
methodology.other_regions: The dataset materializes the target region only. Other valid regions are assumed to have the same configured number of active users and enter through their aggregate recovered-true count when generating the global FA count.
methodology.p_fa: For each slot, the integer number of false decoded full messages is ratio-matched so that conditional expected F/(T+F) equals the requested global P_FA.
methodology.p_md: Each transmitted full message is independently missed with probability P_MD.
